notes.title: The cross-server battle was launched on May 10, 2025~~
notes.content:
Here’s an example:

The requirements for the Silver Cross-Server Battle mainly include the following points:
1. Players must reach level 40 and possess at least 5 generals.
2. You need to form a battle team composed of generals from different professions, with a maximum limit of 3 for each profession.
3. Complete the specified challenge tasks within the given time and earn enough points to advance to the next stage of the competition.

In addition, please note the following: during the competition, you must adhere to the rules and follow the referee's instructions; participants must bear the risk of disqualification due to violations.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45322586/db3e29acb57202aa0ebcf8ce0a2947cafa62093a.png[/img]
Player Strategy 1:
Assess your situation. If you don't want to spend gems, focus on completing tasks and collect what you can. If you have the resources and battle power, you can buy stamina to revive and defeat enemies to earn more tokens. Most importantly, no matter how you play, make sure to finish the tasks. There's also another strategy called "stealing the base." Gather your teammates to attack the enemy's main base; the earlier you finish, the more tokens you will receive. This can yield just as many tokens as completing the tasks, but you must take down the enemy's main base early, preferably within 5 to 10 minutes of the start. If you can’t do that, just play normally as I mentioned at the beginning.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45322586/4f94343d96f96b008bea2f35f0da53418c111198.png[/img]

notes.content:

Dear Players,

We will be resetting the server at the end of December 2024 to provide you with a better gaming experience and ecosystem.

Important Points:
1.All players who have purchased DLC will automatically receive the corresponding DLC rewards upon logging into the game after the reset. Players who have made in-game purchases should contact customer service, and the official team will resend the corresponding rewards via email.
2.All genuine paying players before the server reset will receive a 100% additional compensation in vouchers equal to the amount spent via email.
3.We will open a free demo on Steam, which will have the same content as the full version, with the only difference being the absence of rewards from the full version.
4.Cavalry Charge is a game inspired by excellent industry products such as The Thirty-Six Stratagems, Siege and Conquer, and Strongest King, developed using Unity as a mini-game + Three Kingdoms national battle SLG game.
Thank you for your support and understanding. We look forward to reuniting with you in the new version! Wishing you a great gaming experience!

[Liudao Wuyu Game Studio] Team

notes.content:
The free trial version of "Cavalry Conflict: Three Kingdoms Conquest" is coming soon!

We are excited to announce that the free trial version of the game "Cavalry Conflict: Three Kingdoms Conquest" will officially launch at the end of December! This is a strategic simulation game set against the backdrop of Three Kingdoms history, where players will take on the role of commanders during that era, strategizing, deploying troops, and participating in intense national battles to experience the ups and downs of history and the contest of wisdom.

In this trial version, we hope to allow more players to personally experience the charm and fun of the game. Whether you're a Three Kingdoms enthusiast or a fan of SLG games, we sincerely invite you to try this game. We believe that through your participation, we can work together to create an even better game.

We highly value player feedback and suggestions. During the trial, we encourage every player to actively share their experiences and thoughts. Whether it's feedback on gameplay, interface design, or character balance, your opinions are crucial for us to continuously improve and refine the game. Your voice is vital in helping us enhance the game's quality and user experience.

Stay tuned for the free trial version of "Cavalry Conflict: Three Kingdoms Conquest," and we look forward to seeing you in the game! Let's join hands, battle through the Three Kingdoms, and write our own legendary chapter!

notes.title: Cavalry Charge·Three Kingdoms publish~
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45322586/00499b0e66b4851cdd8fd910f6ab149705ae2780.png[/img]

Content Includes:
Hero Development

A total of 108 heroes, featuring civil officials, military generals, and versatile classes, with unit types such as infantry, cavalry, archers, and sorcerers that counter each other. Heroes also include treasures, destinies, stars, deputy generals, formations, beast spirits, soul jade, battle strategies, reincarnations, and divine beings across eight major gameplay versions.
Fief Construction

Build barracks, resource fields, and technology enhancements within your fief.
Foreign Envoys

Foreign envoys are a national dungeon gameplay; only the rulers of the same nation can simultaneously face their country's foreign envoys. Victory will yield tribute rewards. The foreign envoy dungeons are divided into multiple levels, with higher levels presenting greater difficulty.
Regular National Wars

Players can attack ordinary cities at any time. This type of national war aims to prepare city routes for large-scale national wars, facilitating the occupation of key forts.
Golden City Wars

Large cities can be attacked daily from 12:00 to 14:00 and 20:00 to 22:00. Players can employ tactics such as ambushes and troop restrictions to disrupt the enemy. After capturing a city, more gold rewards will be settled during the autumn harvest each year.
Xiangyang Battle

All players on the server participate in attacking the largest city in the game (Xiangyang). The nation that survives in the main city of Xiangyang will become the overlord when the next Xiangyang battle begins and will receive the overlord rewards.
